description_en: Cancel the association between the user's VPC and VSwitch
kebab_example: aliyun cc5g detach-vpc-from-net-link --wireless-cloud-connector-id cc5g-xxxx --net-link-id cciot-xxxx --region cn-hangzhou
name: DetachVpcFromNetLink

parameters.help_en: The ID of the 5G cloud instance
parameters.name: wireless_cloud_connector_id

parameters.help_en:
Ensures the idempotence of the request. Generate a unique value from your client for this parameter across different requests. The value must contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters.
If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may differ for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。
若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run of the request. Valid values:
true: Sends a dry run request without canceling the association. The system checks whether required parameters are specified, whether the request format is valid, and whether business limits are met. If the check fails, an error is returned. If the check passes, the error code `DryRunOperation` is returned.
false (default): Sends a normal request. If the check passes, the association between the user's VPC and VSwitch is canceled immediately
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会取消关联。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后直接取消用户Vpc和Vswitch的关联
parameters.name: dry_run
